entities.name: Appel bromination product
observations: The substrate terminal primary alcohol is converted from –CH2CH2CH2OH to –CH2CH2CH2Br while the heterocyclic scaffold remains unchanged.

entities.name: Appel bromination CBr4 PPh3
observations: Appel-type bromination of a primary alcohol using carbon tetrabromide and triphenylphosphine.
Encoded solvents are dichloromethane and tetrahydrofuran.
